title: Establish Branch + Trail + Office Review as the temporal counterpart to the Institutional Atlas
summary: Formalize maturation, adjudication, execution, trace, and institutional-state transitions so the Hall exposes participable work rather than only repository endpoints.

origin.signal: External evaluation could orient and traverse the public portal but could not identify a responsible contribution because active institutional work and maturation were not visible.

intent: Make institutional change legible through one Branch lifecycle shared by Notion/Office, Hall projections, GitHub execution, and Trace.
evidence: Notion Sovereign Intelligence HQ is the operating workspace above the repository layer.
Notion TYME Hall record describes HQ as the current internal workspace equivalent of Hall.
External portal evaluation reported that orientation and repository traversal work but active contribution targets are not visible.
hypotheses: A normalized Branch/Trail lifecycle can make participable institutional work discoverable without reducing the institution to a manually maintained backlog.
unresolved_questions: Which existing Notion databases and pages should map directly to Branch fields versus remain source artifacts?
Which lifecycle states should be binding Canon versus operational vocabulary?
What minimum Hall projection is sufficient for a second external-intelligence evaluation?
